spec.description: For 86.7% of the graph we do not know whether a row is a person or a company. The README frames the human/organisation split as a solved design decision; the design is right and the data does not implement it. This is the single largest quality deficit by row count and it directly degrades decisions D1 (who maintains my dependencies) and D2 (who should I talk to), where top results come back as organisations rather than people.
